gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients with radiographic evidence of suggestive of a primary high-grade glioma

candidate_evidence.quote: Laser interstitial thermal therapy (LITT) followed by hypo-fractionated radiation therapy, 25Gy/10 fractions.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: LITT Followed by Hypofractionated RT for Newly Diagnosed Gliomas (GCC 20138)

coder_notes: Procedure (LITT) plus hypofractionated radiotherapy only; no drug or biologic interventions registered or stated as given to all patients. Phase NA (expected to fail S3 at CODE layer). Glioblastoma named in conditions; eligibility is high-grade glioma generally.
